title: Product GTM Manager
jobDescription:

The role sits within the Product team and works closely with Sales, Consulting/Solutioning, Customer Success, Marketing, and Engineering. This person will translate product capabilities into client value, support strategic demos and requirement discussions, enable business teams, and convert market feedback into product growth opportunities and roadmap inputs. Location: Bangalore Reporting Manager: Chief Of Product & Co-founder Key

Partner with Sales, Consulting/Solutioning, and Customer Success teams to position product capabilities against client needs and business outcomes. Translate customer requirements into product narratives, use cases, demos, and solution-fit recommendations. Create and maintain product pitch decks, demo flows, battlecards, FAQs, product capability documents, and sales enablement material. Support RFP/RFI responses, enterprise proposals, and strategic account discussions from a product perspective. Train internal teams on product capabilities, releases, use cases, customer-facing positioning, and objection handling. Support product launches through GTM plans, enablement assets, launch messaging, demo scripts, and adoption plays. Commercial Product Management: Capture recurring client needs, market requirements, competitive insights, and product gaps from business-facing conversations. Convert market and client feedback into structured product inputs for Product and Engineering teams. Identify opportunities to improve product adoption, revenue, expansion, packaging, and customer value realization. Work with Product leadership to prioritize commercial opportunities based on market demand, strategic value, and product feasibility. Product Growth & Adoption: Define use cases and customer journeys that improve product adoption, usage, expansion, and measurable customer value. Support Customer Success teams with product-led adoption plans, value realization frameworks, and customer proof points. Monitor competitor offerings, market shifts, and emerging trends relevant to product positioning and growth. Required Experience: 4-6 years of experience in Product Management, Product Marketing, Product GTM, Growth Product, Commercial Product Management, or related roles. Strong understanding of B2B Saa S, HR Tech, Learning Tech, AI products, or enterprise technology products. Strong ability to synthesize customer requirements, market feedback, and business needs into actionable product insights. Excellent communication, storytelling, presentation, and stakeholder management skills. Prior Product Manager, Product Marketing Manager, Growth Product Manager, or Commercial Product Manager experience. Exposure to enterprise sales cycles, RFPs/RFIs, solution mapping, or strategic account support. title: Lead Content
jobDescription:
Job Description – Lead Content Developer (Content and Facilitation) About the Role The Lead Content Developer will be responsible for the creation, development, and oversight of engaging and effective learning materials tailored for audiences at various leadership levels. This role demands creativity, a passion for training, strong attention to detail, and leadership skills. Additionally, the Lead Content Developer will mentor junior team members and stay abreast of industry trends and emerging tools and technologies to continuously improve content development processes.
1. Stakeholder Analysis Conduct and lead stakeholder conversations to comprehend client needs, challenges, and requirements. Develop comprehensive stakeholder analysis reports and obtain client sign-off. Gain a deep understanding of assigned projects and client needs to ensure alignment with organizational goals.
2. Content Design, Development, and Maintenance Understand complex business problem statements, learner profiles, and advanced evaluation methodologies to design effective learning solutions. Apply advanced adult learning principles in content development. Utilize various techniques and methodologies to create training content that addresses different learning styles. Develop sophisticated training collaterals such as quizzes, assessments, reading materials, case studies, exercises, and activities tailored for higher-level leadership. Conduct extensive research to contextualize content to the client's industry needs and challenges. Leverage Generative AI and AI-powered research tools to accelerate content research, ideation, and content development while ensuring accuracy, quality, and alignment with client requirements. Create detailed instructor notes to complement training material. Conduct walkthroughs of the training content with clients and facilitators to secure approval. Utilize advanced authoring tools like Articulate and Captivate for creating learning materials. Integrate innovative tools and technologies to enhance content delivery and engagement.
3. Industry Trends and Technology Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in content development and training. Explore and implement new tools and technologies to improve content development processes and outcomes. Evaluate and adopt AI-enabled content creation and learning technologies to enhance productivity, learner engagement, and training effectiveness. Evaluate and adopt cutting-edge learning technologies and methodologies to enhance training effectiveness.
4. Mentorship and Team Development Mentor and provide guidance to junior content developers. Facilitate knowledge sharing and skill development within the team. Foster a collaborative and supportive team environment to promote continuous learning and improvement.
5. Internal Stakeholder Management Collaborate with internal stakeholders to get sign-off for the designed solutions. Communicate effectively with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and support for content initiatives.
6. Process Improvement Track and analyze feedback on all content elements from internal teams, client stakeholders, and facilitators. Implement corrective measures based on feedback to improve content quality. Build and maintain a comprehensive content repository. Focus on process improvements and automation to enhance efficiency and effectiveness in content development. Identify opportunities to leverage AI-driven automation and reusable content assets to improve development speed, consistency, and scalability.
